scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix functions
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.validate:release: npm run typecheck --prefix client && npm run lint --prefix client && npm run test:policy --prefix client && npm run check:cycles && npm run check:operations-docs && npm run audit:production && npm run build --prefix client && npm run performance:check --prefix client && npm run smoke:preview --prefix client && npm run test --prefix server && npm run test:rules && npm run test:e2e:pwa && npm run test:e2e
scripts.deploy: npm run validate:release && firebase deploy --only database
scripts.test: npm run typecheck --prefix client && npm run lint --prefix client && npm run test:policy --prefix client && npm run test --prefix server
scripts.audit:production: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm audit --prefix client --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm audit --prefix server --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm audit --prefix functions --omit=dev --audit-level=high
